data.title: Polymarket launches 15-minute Bitcoin price markets on US app
data.description: Polymarket launched its "Bitcoin Up or Down" markets on its US app on September 22, 2026, at 12:00 PM ET. The product lets users wager on whether Bitcoin's price will finish above or below a reference price at the close of each 15-minute window. Markets run continuously, 24 hours a day, seven days…
